A celebrity shootout in Mumbai has sent shockwaves through the financial capital and has spread fear in the Hindi film industry. This wasn’t the first shootout in the city this year. The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The petition alleged that police had failed to probe the case with the seriousness it merits and, hence, sought the probe to be monitored by a retired judge

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Woman rams multiple vehicles, tries to run over cops in Mumbai; booked
